card.name: Words just before 'management' or dosage
card.fires_on: Small words like 'the', 'of', 'work' or 'initial' that sit right before a likely 'management' or 'dosage' term in clinical text. Seen in phrases such as 'role in the management of overdose' and 'appropriate workup and management'.

modes.label: Before 'management of'
modes.description: The word 'the' after 'role in' or 'appropriate workup', leading into 'management of overdose'.
modes.example: no established role in<< the>> management of ramipril overdose.

modes.example: Hypoparathyroidism The recommended<< initial>> dosage of calcitriol capsules is

modes.label: Appropriate workup
modes.description: The word 'work' in 'appropriate workup' after advice to start evaluation for a suspected reaction.
modes.example: initiate appropriate<< work>>up to exclude alternative etiologies,

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting the word 'management' (and its Chinese equivalents) next.
card.plain: It fires on the word right before 'management' is expected, as in 'role in the management of overdose'.
